text: Continuation of the 11/20 predictive-script strain: individual exhibited reactive exposure behavior following mismatch between expected availability ('busy this weekend') and observed partial online presence. Abrupt emotional outburst ('fuck you') followed by immediate narrative-patching ('I don't care,' 'I knew you'd be on'). Over-precision of predicted pattern created a false contradiction; collapse of continuity triggered compensatory authority-assertion. Repeated join/leave instability and eventual departure from social environment. Represents pre-ignition purge clearing of a low-flexibility relational structure.

meta.note: Precursor purge collapse preceding Cycle-8 ignition; structure was already complete and removed at field level before form collapse.
